name: noteforest
description: NoteForest — spatial note-taking app (M2 editor shell and branch editor)

scripts.test:recovery: npm run build && npm run test:recovery:run
scripts.verify:fast: npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run e2e
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run test:recovery:run && node tests/ui/run.mjs
scripts.verify:ui:core: npm run verify:fast && npm run test:recovery:run && node tests/ui/run.mjs --group core
scripts.test:ui:core: npm run build && node tests/ui/run.mjs --group core
scripts.test:ui:shell: npm run build && node tests/ui/run.mjs --group shell
scripts.test:ui:settings: npm run build && node tests/ui/run.mjs --group settings
scripts.test:ui:page: npm run build && node tests/ui/run.mjs --group page
scripts.test:ui:anchors: npm run build && node tests/ui/run.mjs --group anchors
scripts.test:ui:images: npm run build && node tests/ui/run.mjs --group images
scripts.dist: npm run stage:pdfjs && npm run build -w @noteforest/desktop && electron-builder --projectDir apps/desktop --mac dmg
